mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (user_id, topic, message_id, message, state) VALUES (#{userId}, #{topic}, #{messageId}, #{message}, #{state})
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET state = #{state}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, user_id, topic, message_id, message, state, create_time, update_time from task where state = 'fail' or (state = 'create' and TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, update_time, NOW()) > 6) limit 10
